    The one number that changes everything.

    Free calculators, a personalized FI roadmap, and a community of 25K+ on the same journey.

    Industry observers note that "Is Social Security taxable?" is one of the most common tax questions retirees ask — and the answer frustrates almost everyone: it depends. Depending on your total income, anywhere from 0% to 85% of your Social Security benefits can be subject to federal income tax. The tax was introduced in 1983, originally affecting about 10% of recipients. Today, because the income thresholds were never indexed for inflation, roughly 56% of Social Security recipients pay tax on their benefits.

    Industry observers note that the good news: even in the worst case, you'll never pay tax on 100% of your Social Security. The bad news: the formula for calculating the taxable amount is one of the most convoluted in the entire tax code. In this guide, we'll break it down into plain English, show you exactly how to calculate what you owe, and — most importantly — share strategies the FI community uses to reduce or eliminate the tax entirely.

    According to recent reports, the IRS uses a special formula called "combined income" (also called "provisional income") to determine how much of your Social Security benefits are taxable. Here's the formula:.

    Combined Income = Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) + Nontaxable Interest + Half of Social Security Benefits.

    Recent findings suggest that the resulting number determines which taxation tier you fall into. Notice that the thresholds haven't changed since 1993 — they are not adjusted for inflation, which means more retirees cross into taxable territory every year.

    Crucial: "Up to 85% taxed" does not mean you pay an 85% tax rate. It means 85% of your benefits are added to your taxable income and taxed at your ordinary income rate. If you're in the 22% bracket and 85% of your $30,000 benefit is taxable, you'd owe 22% on $25,500 — roughly $5,610.

    This is the most common Social Security tax confusion. When the IRS indicates "up to 85% of benefits are taxable," it means 85% of your benefit amount gets added to your taxable income and taxed at your regular rate. If your marginal rate is 22% and 85% of your $30,000 benefit is taxable, you owe about $5,610 — not $25,500. The effective tax rate on your full benefit in this example is about 18.7%.

    Let's walk through a real example. Meet Sarah: she's 67, single, retired, and receives $24,000 per year in Social Security benefits. She also has $18,000 in IRA withdrawals and $2,000 in municipal bond interest.

    Step 1: Calculate Combined Income.

    According to recent reports, step 2: Determine the Tier Sarah is single with combined income of $32,000, which falls between $25,000 and $34,000. She's in the 50% tier — up to 50% of her benefits may be taxable.

    It has been revealed that step 3: Calculate the Taxable Amount The actual calculation involves comparing two formulas and taking the lesser amount. For the 50% tier:.

    It has been revealed that sarah adds $3,500 to her other taxable income. At a 12% marginal rate, that's roughly $420 in additional federal tax on her Social Security.

    Beyond federal taxes, 13 states also tax Social Security benefits to some degree as of 2026. Each state has its own thresholds and exemption amounts:.

    The remaining 37 states and Washington, D.C. do not tax Social Security benefits at all. If you're planning where to retire, this is a meaningful factor — especially if you have substantial SS benefits combined with other retirement income.

    The FI community has identified several strategies that can significantly reduce the tax bite on Social Security benefits. The key insight: since taxation is based on combined income, controlling your income in retirement is the lever.

    Industry observers note that this is the single most powerful strategy. Roth IRA withdrawals are not included in the combined income formula. If you retire early (before Social Security age), you have a window of low-income years to convert Traditional IRA/401(k) money to Roth.

    In a recent development, example: Between ages 55 and 67, you convert $500,000 from your Traditional IRA to a Roth — paying tax at rates as low as 10-12%. When you claim Social Security at 67, your Roth withdrawals don't push you into a higher SS taxation tier. Instead of 85% of your benefits being taxable, you might pay tax on 0-50%.

    Recent findings suggest that the math is dramatic over a 25+ year retirement. Converting at 12% during early retirement to avoid 22%+ taxation on Social Security for decades produces enormous tax savings.

    Every dollar of AGI pushes you toward the 50% or 85% taxation tiers. Strategic levers include:.

    It has been revealed that once you reach age 70.5, you can donate up to $105,000 per year directly from your IRA to a qualified charity. This satisfies your Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) without the distribution being included in your AGI. Lower AGI means lower combined income, which means less Social Security is taxable.

    For charitably inclined retirees, QCDs are one of the most tax-efficient giving strategies available — they simultaneously reduce your income tax AND reduce the tax on your Social Security benefits.

    In a recent development, delaying Social Security from 62 to 70 increases your benefit by roughly 77%. But there's a secondary benefit: during the delay years, you have more room to do Roth conversions at low tax rates without Social Security benefits adding to your combined income. The combination of larger benefits and lower taxation on those benefits makes delay doubly powerful for tax optimization.

    If you retire before claiming Social Security, you have a golden window for Roth conversions. With little or no earned income and no SS benefits, you can convert Traditional IRA money to Roth at the lowest tax brackets of your lifetime. Every dollar you convert is a dollar that will never increase the tax on your Social Security benefits. This window closes permanently once you start claiming.

    A step-by-step walkthrough for estimating what you owe.

    List your AGI from all sources: IRA/401(k) withdrawals, pension income, wages, dividends, capital gains, rental income. Get your total Social Security benefit from your SSA-1099 form.

    Pro tip: Don't forget nontaxable municipal bond interest — it counts in the combined income formula even though it's not on your 1040.

    Recent findings suggest that add your AGI + nontaxable interest + half of your Social Security benefits. This "combined income" number determines your taxation tier.

    Compare your combined income to the thresholds: Single — $25K (50% tier), $34K (85% tier). Married filing jointly — $32K (50% tier), $44K (85% tier).

    According to recent reports, for the 50% tier: take 50% of combined income above the lower threshold (capped at 50% of benefits). For the 85% tier: the calculation is more complex — use IRS Publication 915 worksheet or tax software.

    Pro tip: Tax software handles this automatically. If doing it by hand, IRS Publication 915 has the complete worksheet.

    The taxable portion of your Social Security gets added to your other taxable income and taxed at your marginal rate. Check if your state also taxes Social Security.

    For single filers, Social Security becomes partially taxable when combined income exceeds $25,000 (50% tier) and up to 85% taxable above $34,000. For married filing jointly, the thresholds are $32,000 (50% tier) and $44,000 (85% tier). These thresholds have not changed since 1993 and are not indexed for inflation.

    It has been revealed that no. Social Security benefits are not earned income. They are classified as unearned income for tax purposes. This distinction matters for things like the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC), IRA contribution eligibility, and the Social Security earnings test (which only applies to earned income like wages and self-employment).

    No — and this is why Roth accounts are so powerful in retirement. Roth IRA withdrawals are not included in the combined income formula used to determine Social Security taxation. Converting Traditional IRA money to Roth before claiming Social Security can dramatically reduce the tax on your benefits for life.

    It has been revealed that yes. File Form W-4V with the Social Security Administration to have federal income tax withheld from your benefits. You can choose 7%, 10%, 12%, or 22% withholding. This avoids the surprise of a large tax bill at filing time. State tax withholding varies by state.

    Sources indicate that social Security benefits are included in the Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) calculation that determines Medicare Part B and Part D premium surcharges (IRMAA). High-income retirees can pay significantly more for Medicare — up to 3.4 times the standard premium. Managing MAGI in retirement affects both Social Security taxation and Medicare costs.

    Recent findings suggest that there have been numerous proposals to reform Social Security taxation, including indexing the thresholds for inflation, raising the taxable percentage above 85%, or eliminating the tax entirely. As of 2026, no changes have been enacted. The thresholds have remained unchanged since 1993, meaning inflation automatically pushes more retirees into taxable territory each year.

    Yes, Social Security benefits can be taxable — up to 85% of your benefits may be added to your taxable income depending on your combined income. The thresholds are low ($25,000 single, $32,000 married) and haven't been adjusted for inflation since 1993, catching more retirees every year. The single most powerful strategy is Roth conversions during early retirement years before claiming Social Security. Every dollar in a Roth account is a dollar that won't push your Social Security into the taxable zone. Blueprint your retirement income sources deliberately, and you can reduce or eliminate this tax entirely.

    💡 Key Takeaways
    • According to recent reports, in 2026, many teams still default to WordPress when building blogs or marketing sites, often without fully considering the architectural alternatives.
    • Modern visitors now expect lightning-fast page loads and perfect Core Web Vitals a bar that traditional WordPress setups struggle to meet without extensive optimization and caching strategies.
    • Industry observers note that this article examines why, for many developer-managed websites, Astro + Cloudflare Pages delivers superior results in performance, SEO, security, and maintainability compared to traditional WordPress deployments.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    According to recent reports, in 2026, many teams still default to WordPress when building blogs or marketing sites, often without fully considering the architectural alternatives. The classic WordPress setup PHP on shared hosting or managed WordPress platforms, coupled with a MySQL database and a plugin ecosystem works reliably but comes with inherent performance trade-offs.

    Modern visitors now expect lightning-fast page loads and perfect Core Web Vitals a bar that traditional WordPress setups struggle to meet without extensive optimization and caching strategies.

    Industry observers note that this article examines why, for many developer-managed websites, Astro + Cloudflare Pages delivers superior results in performance, SEO, security, and maintainability compared to traditional WordPress deployments. We'll explore the technical trade-offs and help you make an informed decision for your next blog or business website.

    It has been revealed that astro is a modern web framework that prioritizes delivering fast, lightweight content by default. Instead of running client-side JavaScript on every page load, Astro generates complete HTML during build time. Only interactive elements—dubbed "islands of interactivity"—run JavaScript, and only when needed.

    Cloudflare Pages is a globally distributed static hosting platform that leverages Cloudflare's edge network for content delivery. Think of it as Git combined with Cloudflare's CDN and security stack with integrated CI/CD, zero-downtime deployments, and automatic edge caching.

    You write your content and components using Astro's Markdown, MDX, or frameworks Astro builds your site to static HTML during your CI/CD pipeline Cloudflare Pages takes the built static assets and deploys them to edge locations worldwide Every request hits the nearest edge location, serving cache-optimized HTML directly.

    This contrasts sharply with WordPress, which typically involves:.

    PHP processing on every request Database queries to fetch content Server-side template rendering Dynamic page generation per visitor.

    The result: WordPress delivers pages via server-side rendering, while Astro + Cloudflare Pages delivers pages via edge-based static serving.

    Astro sites start with a clean slate: static HTML by default. This means:.

    Zero JavaScript by default – Pages load instantly with just HTML Minimal HTTP requests – Bundles are eliminated from the initial response Small page weight – Often under 50KB for content pages Instant first paint – No rendering blockers.

    Real-world tests and case studies consistently show Astro sites achieving near-perfect Lighthouse performance scores. The initial page load times typically range from 0.5s to 1.5s for content-heavy sites, compared to 2s to 5s for typical WordPress installations.

    WordPress usually involves several performance bottlenecks:.

    PHP rendering on every request – Server-side template processing delays first byte Database queries – MySQL lookups add tens to hundreds of milliseconds Plugin overhead – Even maintenance plugins add significant JavaScript and processing Theme scripts – Most themes include jQuery and other bloat by default.

    These differences translate directly into Core Web Vitals:.

    LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) – Astro typically achieves under 1.5s, while WordPress often lands between 2-3s without extensive caching CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) – Astro's static nature means predictable layouts. WordPress experiences frequent layout shifts during dynamic content loading FID (First Input Delay) – Lower JavaScript payloads in Astro mean better interactivity FCP (First Contentful Paint) – Static HTML delivers content instantly, while WordPress waits for PHP to parse and render.

    The performance gap becomes more pronounced on mobile networks and in regions far from hosting servers. Since Cloudflare Pages serves content from their global edge network, the geographic distance factor disappears entirely.

    Static HTML serves SEO exceptionally well because:.

    Fast pages are prioritized by Google – Poor Core Web Vitals directly impact rankings Simple, crawlable markup – Search engines can parse clean HTML instantly without JavaScript Predictable content delivery – Same markup for all visitors regardless of device or traffic source.

    WordPress's JavaScript-heavy pages force Googlebot to execute JavaScript a process that's become more sophisticated but still less reliable than serving static HTML.

    Astro offers granular control over SEO elements:.

    Content collections and frontmatter provide structured data management:.

    Astro integrates seamlessly with popular SEO tooling:.

    Robots.txt generation via Astro's sitemap integration Structured data through @astrojs/sitemap and JSON-LD Meta tags automatically generated from frontmatter Image optimization via @astrojs/image, supporting WebP, lazy loading, and responsive sizes.

    Cloudflare Pages provides several SEO-specific benefits:.

    Global CDN distribution – Pages serve from 280+ edge locations Zero-Time to First Byte (TTFB) – Edge caching eliminates server latency Built-in SSL/HTTPS – No mixed content warnings Automatic performance optimization – Image compression, HTML minification.

    These factors combine to create a superior SEO foundation where pages load in under 500ms with perfect Core Web Vitals, immediately signaling relevance to search engines.

    The combination of fast performance, clean HTML, and reliable crawling translates to:.

    Faster indexing – Pages crawled and ranked immediately Higher visibility – Better Core Web Vitals improve rankings Better user engagement – Faster pages reduce bounce rates and increase dwell time Improved Zero-Click Searches – Perfect page structure for featured snippets and search features.

    Modern developer workflows prioritize speed and reliability:.

    Commit → Deploy – Automatic deployments directly from git branches Zero infrastructure management – No cPanel, FTP, or server administration Consistent environments – Same code runs identically across dev, staging, and prod Version control for content – Content is text files, fully version-controlled.

    Traditional WordPress workflows involve:.

    Content management through admin dashboard – HTML editors, plugin dependencies Theme and plugin management – Version control challenges for non-developers Performance tuning – Caching plugins, database optimization, CDN integration Security maintenance – Regular updates, vulnerability patches, backup systems.

    The WordPress approach demands significant operational overhead to achieve acceptable performance, while Astro + Cloudflare Pages delivers optimal performance by design.

    Astro + Cloudflare Pages: Only pay for Cloudflare usage ($5-20/month for hobby initiative, $20-100+ for pro tier) WordPress: Hosting ($10-50/month) + Premium plugins/themes ($20-100+/year) + Maintenance costs.

    In a recent development, performance is critical? → Astro + Cloudflare Pages Non-technical content creators needed? → WordPress Complex dynamic features required? → WordPress Budget is a primary concern? → Astro + Cloudflare Pages Developer-first approach preferred? → Astro + Cloudflare Pages Existing WordPress investment? → Consider WordPress (but evaluate migration ROI).

    **For most modern developer-managed projects, especially blogs, documentation sites, and marketing pages:.

    Total Cost: ~60-70% less with Astro + Cloudflare Pages Performance: Significantly better (0.5s vs 2-5s load times) Maintainability: Much easier (CI/CD vs ongoing administration) Security: Stronger (no database, fewer attack vectors) Developer Experience: Superior (modern toolchain vs legacy admin).

    Choose WordPress when you need:.

    Visual content editing without code Complex plugin ecosystems (e-commerce, memberships) Existing WordPress team skills Rapid feature deployment without developer involvement.

    This comparison should make it crystal clear which platform serves your specific needs best, with the financial implications being a major deciding factor in 2026's cost-conscious environment.

    It has been revealed that wordPress approach: Typical SaaS marketing site would require multiple plugins for lead generation, analytics, and contact forms. Performance optimization needs caching plugins, CDN integration, and database cleanup. Security requires Wordfence or similar WAF.

    Astro + Cloudflare Pages approach: Lead form implemented via Astro's forms API or a lightweight service like Netlify Forms. Analytics with Astro integrations. Simple, fast pages that convert better due to performance.

    Industry observers note that why Astro wins: Marketing sites benefit immediately from faster loads and better SEO. The lightweight approach reduces maintenance overhead and improves conversion rates.

    Sources indicate that astro + Cloudflare Pages approach: Syntax highlighting built into Astro syntax highlighting. Comments via third-party services (Disqus, Utterances). Static generation means instant page loads even with hundreds of posts.

    Why Astro wins: Developer audiences expect fast loading, especially for code-heavy content. Static generation eliminates database overhead and delivers instant page loads.

    News sites with tight publishing deadlines Sites requiring complex dynamic features (membership, e-commerce) Organizations with non-technical content teams Existing WordPress investments with extensive custom development.

    Moving from WordPress to Astro requires careful planning:.

    Use redirects to maintain SEO equity Implement 301 redirects for changed URLs Consider using tools like next-redirect or Cloudflare's redirect rules.

    Submit updated sitemap.xml Monitor crawl rate changes Verify canonical tags are set correctly.

    According to recent reports, the choice between WordPress and Astro + Cloudflare Pages depends heavily on your specific use case, team expertise, and long-term goals. However, for most modern blogs, documentation sites, and business websites, Astro + Cloudflare Pages provides the superior foundation.

    You need performance first – When Core Web Vitals and user experience are priorities You have developer expertise – When your team can manage content through code and version control You want low maintenance – When you prefer simplicity over extensive plugin ecosystems You need global reach – When serving users worldwide with consistent performance You prioritize SEO – When search rankings and visibility are critical.

    Zero-compromise performance – Static HTML serves instantly from edge locations Developer-friendly workflows – Git-based deployment and modern CI/CD Strong security posture – No database, less attack surface, Cloudflare protection SEO-ready by design – Fast pages, clean markup, global distribution Scalable architecture – Handles growth without performance degradation.

    WordPress still holds value in specific scenarios, but for performance-critical, developer-managed sites in 2026, Astro on Cloudflare Pages represents the modern standard for web development.

    Ready to prototype your next blog or marketing site using this approach? Start with Astro's starter templates and Cloudflare Pages' Git integration then measure your performance gains and SEO improvements against your current WordPress installation. The difference in user experience and search rankings will speak for itself.

    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Sources indicate that A column rename can leave application queries referring to a name that no longer exists.
    • Recent findings suggest that SH-PSCBS is my experimental tool for connecting those two sides.
    • The demo renames a column, highlights a SQL diff, runs pytest, and verifies an approved commit against a disposable local Git remote.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Sources indicate that A column rename can leave application queries referring to a name that no longer exists. A migration changes the database, but the application still needs a compatible change.

    Recent findings suggest that SH-PSCBS is my experimental tool for connecting those two sides. It detects PostgreSQL schema differences and prepares code repair proposals for review.

    The demo renames a column, highlights a SQL diff, runs pytest, and verifies an approved commit against a disposable local Git remote. Model responses are simulated, so no API key or Ollama installation is required for this example.

    Each detected change becomes an event. The workflow can need clarification, a correction, another validation attempt, or a human decision. LangGraph expresses those routes, while SQLite stores snapshots, event state, and decisions.

    Analysis identifies schema changes and code evidence. Planning uses Groq with read-only tools. Correction uses Ollama in an isolated project copy. Validation checks integrity and syntax and runs pytest in a network-isolated Docker container. Review compares the plan, diff, and results.

    Industry observers note that affiliate marketing is a way to make money by promoting the products and services of other people and companies. You don't need to create your product or service, just promote existing ones. That's why it's so easy to get started with affiliate marketing. You can even get started with no budget at all!

    In a recent development, an affiliate program is a package of information you create for your product, which is then made available to potential publishers. The program will typically include details about the product and its retail value, commission levels, and promotional materials. Many affiliate programs are managed via an affiliate network like ShareASale, which acts as a platform to connect publishers and advertisers, but it is also possible to offer your program directly.

    Industry observers note that affiliate networks connect publishers to advertisers. Affiliate networks make money by charging fees to the merchants who advertise with them; these merchants are known as advertisers. The percentage of each sale that the advertiser pays is negotiated between the merchant and the affiliate network.

    Industry observers note that dropshipping is a method of selling that allows you to run an online store without having to stock products. You advertise the products as if you owned them, but when someone makes an order, you create a duplicate order with the distributor at a reduced price. The distributor takes care of the post and packaging on your behalf. As affiliate marketing is based on referrals and this type of drop shipping requires no investment in inventory when a customer buys through the affiliate link, no money exchanges hands.

    Performance marketing is a method of marketing that pays for performance, like when a sale is made or an ad is clicked This can include methods like PPC (pay-per-click) or display advertising. Affiliate marketing is one form of performance marketing where commissions are paid out to affiliates on a performance basis when they click on their affiliate link and make a purchase or action.

    It has been revealed that smartphones are essentially miniature computers, so publishers can display the same websites and offers that are available on a PC. But mobiles also offer specific tools not available on computers, and these can be used to good effect for publishers. Publishers can optimize their ads for mobile people by making them easy to access by this audience. Publishers can also make good use of text and instant messaging to promote their offers. As the mobile market is predicted to make up 80% of traffic in the future, publishers who do not promote on mobile devices are missing out on a significant opportunity.

    According to recent reports, the best way to find affiliate publishers is on reputable networks like ShareASale Cj(Commission Junction), Awin, and Impact radius. These networks have a strict application process and compliance checks, which means that all affiliates are trustworthy.

    An affiliate disclosure statement discloses to the reader that there may be affiliate links on a website, for which a commission may be paid to the publisher if visitors follow these links and make purchases.

    Publishers promote their programs through a variety of means, including blogs, websites, email marketing, and pay-per-click ads. Social media has a huge interactive audience, making this platform a good source of potential traffic.

    Industry observers note that A super affiliate is an affiliate partner who consistently drives a large majority of sales from any program they promote, compared to other affiliate partners involved in that program. Affiliates make a lot of money from affiliate marketing Pat Flynn earned more than $50000 in 2013 from affiliate marketing.

    7 Best Chain Restaurant Roast Beef Sandwiches, According To Customer Reviews

    📅 17 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 8 min read (1554 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Foodrepublic

    ⏱️ ~8 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Sources indicate that roast beef sandwiches are one of the most hearty and heartening meals there is.
    • According to the latest dedicated study on the subject, a 2019 survey by YouGov found that around 71% of adults across the country enjoyed roast beef sandwiches.
    • Roy Rogers was once famed for its roast beef sandwiches, and today, people still line up for them whenever they get to visit one of the nearly 40 remaining locations.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Sources indicate that roast beef sandwiches are one of the most hearty and heartening meals there is. That's why we think this comfort food deserves to be served year-round, not just on those brisk, rainy days when fall-apart-tender beef on a toasted baguette can be the most delicious way to warm up. Luckily, these chains' roast beef sandwiches are widely praised for their taste, texture, and consistency, so you can be sure you're getting a good-quality meal whenever you'd like to try one.

    And you won't be alone when you do. According to the latest dedicated study on the subject, a 2019 survey by YouGov found that around 71% of adults across the country enjoyed roast beef sandwiches. That's one reason why the restaurants chosen for this list have the sandwich on the menu anytime you want it, and a few even overlap with the chains that have the best French dips. In the end, whatever place you choose to stop at will feed you well with homey, warm roast beef slices on toothsome bread.

    Roy Rogers was once famed for its roast beef sandwiches, and today, people still line up for them whenever they get to visit one of the nearly 40 remaining locations. While it's been in business since the late 1960s, the chain has massively downscaled from its height of almost 650 stores in the 1990s. But the roast beef remains consistently delicious, thanks to the USDA Top Inside Round Roast Beef being slow-cooked for hours for maximum tenderness.

    The sandwich has a hardcore fan base, who often say the beef here is tastier and juicier than other national competitors. One Reddit commenter stated, "Roy's Roast beef is much better than Arby's. It actually tastes like real roast beef." Online reviewers suggest using the chain's barbecue and horseradish sauces to complete the experience. It helps that many of the remaining locations are in Maryland, where you can always grab some Baltimore tiger sauce for any leftovers.

    It has been revealed that and customers are willing to accept the limited regional footprint of the restaurant, although they're still hoping for an overall comeback for the brand. Those lucky enough to have an open Roy Rogers nearby have reported being overjoyed at the discovery.

    Sources indicate that arby's is a nostalgic favorite for many people for a reason – the perfectly textured and easy-to-chew beef. The global fast food chain began operations in 1964 but has since circled the globe with over 3,500 locations without forgetting that fact. That's why the roast beef Arby's uses has had the same four ingredients since it opened — beef, water, salt, and sodium phosphates. The meat is slow-cooked before being thinly sliced and added to a toasted sesame seed bun the diner can customize however they'd like.

    People have called Arby's classic roast beef sandwiches their preferred fast food order, adding they rarely try anything else because the meal is so consistently good. Other fans have echoed that consistency is also what brings them back, with one person saying they've always enjoyed their items from the restaurant. A Facebook user posted about their first time trying Arby's, saying, "Tried Arby's roasted beef sandwich. It is pretty tender and flavorful. It's like a poor man's prime rib." And customers love that they can choose how much meat to have put on the sandwich, with some noting they've enjoyed half-pound versions, with and without cheddar sauce.

    The smallest chain on this list is a Missouri powerhouse that's crossed over into Illinois. Even though that means most people will have to travel a bit to reach the nearest Lion's Choice, fans say the trip will be worth it. That's because the chain's roast beef sandwiches are made from the top round cut and are roasted in-house for freshness. Then there's the firm's proprietary blend of seasoning that's used to finish off the beef after it moves to the bun. The gluten-free mix helps set the meal apart from competitors, just like the secret roasting method does.

    Sources indicate that fans of Lion's Choice are quick to recommend the establishment to newcomers, and those who've moved away look forward to the eatery being one of their first stops upon returning. Guests suggest getting extra seasoning on the beef, with some advising buyers to add cheese as well. The brand's horseradish sauce is also praised for being flavorful, although the beef is always the star of the show.

    Recent findings suggest that black Bear Diner is an up-and-coming chain operating almost 170 locations across 14 states at the time of writing. Founded in 1995, the brand is dedicated to making comfort foods that taste as if they came straight from the best cook in the family's kitchen. The restaurant's Pot Roast Melt is certainly living up to that expectation. The meal is made with jack and cheddar cheeses, grilled onions, horseradish aioli, and slowly simmered pot roast. The sandwich also comes with au jus and is served on garlic- and Parmesan-crusted sourdough bread for a bit of crunch.

    The melt gets consistent praise from customers, whether it's the diner's first time trying the sandwich or if they've come back just for another one. One Facebook user posted about the meal, saying, "Black Bear Diner knocked it out of the park with their Pot Roast Melt! Pot Roast, onion and cheesy goodness on grilled parmesan/garlic bread. On top of that – you get to dip it in au jus!" Others have called it yummy, delicious, and so good, cementing the elevated status of the sandwich for Black Bear Diner fans.

    It has been revealed that like Lion's Choice, Culver's is another Midwest favorite for beef sandwiches. But Culver's is a little different because it's one of the only fast food chains that serves shredded pot roast instead of sliced beef. That creates a big difference in the taste and texture of the premium chuck roast the brand uses, so it's no surprise that Culver's Pot Roast Sandwich is praised for its rich flavor and lack of fat. One person was so impressed with the meal that they made it their go-to item from the menu.

    Other diners point out the generous size of the sandwich, as well as how juicy and tender the meat is. Fans suggest adding gravy and/or grilled onions to finish off the sandwich, but barbecue sauce is another popular way to add spice to the roast. Some people add Swiss cheese and mushrooms, too, although you might need to eat it quickly to keep the bun intact.

    Firehouse Subs is one of the largest fast food sandwich franchises in the U.S., with over 1,300 stores. It started in the mid-1990s and has always been dedicated to making filling meals that each diner could customize exactly as they'd like. The large menu includes hot and cold subs, as well as in-house sides and desserts. One of the most popular hot sandwiches is the Smokehouse Beef & Cheddar Brisket, which fans praise for its melty cheddar cheese, strong beefy flavor, and the incredibly tender brisket.

    People agree that Firehouse Subs is a pricier option than many other sandwich shops, but the quality of the ingredients and the generous portions make up for the higher cost. One Facebook user said, "Trying Firehouse Subs for [the] first time. Large smokehouse beef and cheddar combo, with small fries. Pricier than Subway at $32.42, but bloody delicious!!" Others agree about the taste, saying the sandwich is one of their favorites and that they've had consistently good experiences eating one.

    In a recent development, portillo's is a Chicago-based chain that's best known for its Italian-style roast beef sandwiches, although there are several kinds of roast beef subs on the menu. Served either dipped in au jus or dry, the meaty Italian Beef Sandwiches have a nice kick of spice from the Italian peppers that come atop the layered protein. The meal is so sought after that the business ships kits nationwide to make the Italian beef sandwiches. The set comes with all the elements needed to re-create the meal at home, and it serves up to 10 people.

    In a recent development, reviewers note the hot peppers that come on the sub add a spicy crunch that works nicely with the richness of the juicy meat. One Facebook user posted about the item, saying, "...I had a Portillo's beef yesterday with hot and sweet peppers and dipped twice. It was a pretty darn good beef sandwich.".

    Like that Facebook poster, many fans prefer to have the sandwich dipped, saying the flavor is worth the extra napkins you'll need. Some people even make long drives just to visit the shop. And who could blame them? The hot beef Italian subs offer great taste and value for some of the most tender meat you'll find at any chain restaurant.

    To build a list of the best roast beef sandwiches, we first searched for chain restaurants with more than 24 locations that served the meal. We then looked through social media and message board posts and comments, user review sites, and professional reviews for each chain's roast beef. We ultimately chose the restaurants whose customers had praised the meal for its taste, value, and consistency across multiple platforms to be represented on this list.

    Shake Shack, which has come from humble beginnings as a hot dog cart in Newly introduced York City, has built a loyal following of fans since it first transitioned to permanent kiosks in 2004. From the first, the emphasis of its food has been on the quality of its ingredients. That means cage-free eggs for its breakfast items, 100% beef for its hot dogs, all-natural chicken from cage-free birds, and some of the best Angus beef around, with no added hormones or antibiotics. Indeed, the beef that forms Shake Shack's burger patties is a cut above, a proprietary blend that involves both chuck and brisket, and a spokesperson from Shake Shack told Food Republic that meat is supplied by upscale wholesaler brand Pat LaFrieda Meat Purveyors.

    Described as "one of our longest-standing supplier partners and our largest purveyor by volume," the spokesperson informed us that the source of the partnership harkens back to the founder's, Danny Meyer's, involvement in the NYC fine dining world (Meyer was the original owner of Eleven Madison Park). The collaboration is indicative of Shake Shack's commitment to quality: "Pat LaFrieda helps us deliver the Shake Shack burger our guests know and love, [which is] made with 100% Angus beef, our custom blend of brisket and chuck [has] no preservatives, fillers[,] or additives, always fresh, never frozen, and humanely raised and grazed.".

    It has been revealed that pat LaFrieda has built its reputation on providing quality beef and other meat products to some of the best restaurants in the country, and it has become famous for providing these eating establishments with specialty cuts and portions, its dry-aged beef, and its custom ground beef blends, including (and especially) Shake Shack's. The grinders in its manufacturing plant in Newly introduced Jersey are capable of making more than 150 different unique mixes of ground beef from a variety of cuts, and if you were to partner with the butcher for a restaurant, you could create your own unique recipe.

    In a recent development, and it's benefits like that which has allowed Shake Shack to spread its wings beyond its regular burger menu (which Food Republic tried and ranked) and test out a Dry-Aged Beef Burger at one of its NYC locations. According to the manufacturer's spokesperson, the limited-run burger (the last day to grab one was October 17, 2026) was "made with 35-day dry-aged beef for a deeper, more intense flavor," and it featured absolutely decadent caramelized shallot and a sauce made from bone marrow (as well as raw white onion to add a sharp note in contrast with all the richness), which were all served up on a milk bread bun dotted with black and white sesame seeds.

    #23412. For Creamier, Crispier Grilled Cheese, Make It Disneyland-Style

    📅 17 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 3m • 📚 Deep Dive (561 w)
    📖 Baca
    General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Foodrepublic ↗ Open Full Page

    For Creamier, Crispier Grilled Cheese, Make It Disneyland-Style

    📅 17 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (561 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Foodrepublic

    ⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Recent findings suggest that is there anything more magical than a visit to Disneyland in sunny, beautiful Anaheim, California?
    • According to recent reports, disney actually released the recipe during COVID for its grilled cheese sandwich, which features three different cheeses, as well as a garlic mayo spread for the outside.
    • In a recent development, you might use butter when making your grilled cheeses, but trust us, switching to mayo is the move because it is scientifically disposed to create a more even, crisper crust.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Recent findings suggest that is there anything more magical than a visit to Disneyland in sunny, beautiful Anaheim, California? While the kids might associate this theme park with their favorite Disney characters or the delightful rides and themed areas, many adults make the pricey trek with an additional consideration in mind: the food. In the theme park where Doritos were first served, one can't-miss creation is the Grilled Cheese Sandwich found at the Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (as well as Woody's Lunch Box at Walt Disney World in Florida). If you wanted to replicate its creamy, crispy goodness at home, you might already have the ingredients in your fridge: You'll just need cream cheese for the inside and mayonnaise for the outside.

    According to recent reports, disney actually released the recipe during COVID for its grilled cheese sandwich, which features three different cheeses, as well as a garlic mayo spread for the outside. There's cheddar and provolone, but the cream cheese is the star, as it gets oh-so-gooey and decadent when it melts down, and it adds a slight tang that will make your tongue take immediate interest.

    In a recent development, you might use butter when making your grilled cheeses, but trust us, switching to mayo is the move because it is scientifically disposed to create a more even, crisper crust. Think about it: You can spread it easily in an even layer without worrying about tearing the bread, as you might with butter. And the inclusion of garlic is a master stroke that introduces even more flavorful depth to what is, essentially, a simple sandwich.

    Recent findings suggest that using cream cheese as a filling and mayonnaise as an outer agent of browning is just one way to achieve the grilled cheese of your dreams. While you should absolutely try these two ingredients, we have a few other ideas that can help you achieve the upgraded Disney Parks-inspired sandwich. The first? Cream cheese is just one of three cheeses that go into this toastie; you'll likely use sliced provolone, but at least for the cheddar, you should grate your own. Blocks of cheese that are grated simply melt better than the pre-shredded variety because there are additional ingredients in the latter that help to keep it from clumping, which prohibits it from melting as wonderfully. If you're going to the trouble of including cream cheese to up the gooey-factor, you might as well go full-tilt where the cheddar is concerned. Disney also includes a bit of cream in its cream cheese blend, which will undeniably enhance the richness of the sandwich and keep things gooey for longer. One tablespoon per quarter cup of cream cheese is more than enough.

    To ensure that the sandwich gets its crispiest crust, too, it's notable that you don't drop it into the skillet until the pan is fully heated through(though you can still sprinkle salt onto the pan if you want a little extra seasoning). This is so that the golden outsides can start crisping immediately. At the same time, though, you don't want to have the heat turned up too high — a nice medium to medium-low will do the trick. Any hotter and the outside will burn before the cheese has an opportunity to melt all the way through — not the kind of crispness we're seeking.

    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    In this article, we explore the top 10 AI tools that are driving innovation and efficiency in various industries. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflow, and increase productivity. The tools included in our list are some of the most advanced and widely used in the market, and are suitable for a variety of applications. Some of the tools focus on natural language processing, such as ChatGPT and Grammarly, while others focus on image and video generation, such as DALL-E and Lumen5. Other tools such as OpenAI Codex, Tabnine, Canva, Jasper AI,, and Surfer SEO are designed to help with specific tasks such as code understanding content writing and website optimization. This list is a great starting point for anyone looking to explore the possibilities of AI and how it can be applied to their business or project.

    ChatGPT is a large language model that generates human-like responses to a variety of prompts. It can be used for tasks such as language translation, question answering, and text completion. It can handle a wide range of topics and styles of writing, and generates coherent and fluent text, but should be used with care as it may generate text that is biased, offensive, or factually incorrect.

    Overall, ChatGPT is a powerful tool for natural language processing, but it should be used with care and with an understanding of its limitations.

    It has been revealed that DALL-E is a generative model developed by OpenAI that is capable of generating images from text prompts. It is based on the GPT-3 architecture, which is a transformer-based neural network language model that has been trained on a massive dataset of text. DALL-E can generate images that are similar to a training dataset and it can generate high-resolution images that are suitable for commercial use.

    Overall, DALL-E is a powerful AI-based tool for generating images, it can be used for a variety of applications such as creating images for commercial use, gaming, and other creative projects. It is notable to note that the generated images should be reviewed and used with care, as they may not be entirely original and could be influenced by the training data.

    Lumen5 is a content creation platform that uses AI to help users create videos, social media posts, and other types of content. It has several features that make it useful for content creation and marketing, including:.

    Overall, Lumen5 is a useful tool for creating content swiftly and easily, it can help automate the process of creating videos, social media posts, and other types of content. However, the quality of the generated content may vary depending on the source material and it is crucial to review and edit the content before publishing it.

    Grammarly is a writing-enhancement platform that uses AI to check for grammar, punctuation, and spelling errors in the text. It also provides suggestions for improving the clarity, concision, and readability of the text. It has several features that make it useful for improving writing, including:.

    According to recent reports, openAI Codex is a system developed by OpenAI that can create code from natural language descriptions of software tasks. The system is based on the GPT-3 model and can generate code in multiple programming languages.

    Overall, OpenAI Codex is a powerful tool that can help automate the process of writing code and make it more accessible to non-technical people. However, the quality of the generated code may vary depending on the task description and it is crucial to review and test the code before using it in a production environment. It is important to use the tool as an aid, not a replacement for the developer's knowledge.

    Tabnine is a code completion tool that uses AI to predict and suggest code snippets. It is compatible with multiple programming languages and can be integrated with various code editors.

    Recent findings suggest that overall, TabNine is a useful tool for developers that can help improve coding efficiency and reduce the time spent on writing code. However, it is crucial to review the suggestions provided by the tool and use them with caution, as they may not always be accurate or appropriate. It is important to use the tool as an aid, not a replacement for the developer's knowledge.

    Jasper is a content writing and content generation tool that uses artificial intelligence to identify the best words and sentences for your writing style and medium in the most efficient, quick, and accessible way.

    Sources indicate that surfer SEO is a software tool designed to help website owners and digital marketers improve their search engine optimization (SEO) efforts. The tool provides a variety of features that can be used to analyze a website's on-page SEO, including:.

    Overall, Surfer SEO can be a useful tool for website owners and digital marketers looking to improve their SEO efforts. However, it is crucial to remember that it is just a tool and should be used in conjunction with other SEO best practices. Additionally, the tool is not a guarantee of better ranking.

    It has been revealed that zapier is a web automation tool that allows people to automate repetitive tasks by connecting different web applications together. It does this by creating "Zaps" that automatically move data between apps, and can also be used to trigger certain actions in one app based on events in another app.

    Sources indicate that overall, Zapier is a useful tool that can help users automate repetitive tasks and improve workflow. It can save time and increase productivity by connecting different web applications together. However, it may require some technical skills and some features may require a paid subscription. It is important to use the tool with caution and not to rely too much on it, to understand the apps better.

    Compose AI is a company that specializes in developing natural language generation (NLG) software. Their software uses AI to automatically generate written or spoken text from structured data, such as spreadsheets, databases, or APIs.

    Overall, Compose AI's NLG software can be a useful tool for automating the process of creating written or spoken content from structured data. However, the quality of the generated content may vary depending on the data source, and it is essential to review the generated content before using it in a production environment. It is important to use the tool as an aid, not a replacement for the understanding of the data.

    Recent findings suggest that AI tools are becoming increasingly important in today's business and technology landscape. They are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflow, and increase productivity. The top 10 AI tools included in this article are some of the most advanced and widely used in the market, and are suitable for various applications. Whether you're looking to improve your natural language processing, create high-resolution images, or optimize your website, there is an AI tool that can help. It's important to research and evaluate the different tools available to determine which one is the best fit for your specific needs. As AI technology continues to evolve, these tools will become even more powerful and versatile and will play an even greater role in shaping the future of business and technology.

    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    There are quite a few challenges, actually, when it comes to working at McDonald's. There's a lot of time management involved, as well as customer service and interaction, to say nothing of the physical fatigue from being on your feet for hours. Then there's the actual assembly of the food itself, and while the burger chain with nearly 42,000 locations across the globe has automated many facets of its kitchen, for the most part, employees must still work the machines and put the sandwiches together. So all this begs the question: Is there a menu item that is the hardest to prepare? Food Republic spoke with Tristen Epps-Long, who won Season 22 of "Top Chef" and who is actually a former McDonald's chef, and in his opinion, the dubious honor belongs to the Big Mac.

    Industry observers note that his reasoning? "It's multi-layered," he said. And there's the fact that there isn't a mold; it's all hand-stacked, with many different parts, including three buns, two burger patties, a slice of cheese, pickles, onion, and lettuce. "It was just a bit more hand work," Epps-Long told us. It seems other McDonald's employees agree with our expert, too, as one person on Reddit reported they had a coworker almost quit after receiving an order for 12 Massive Macs at once. It is worth noting, though, that Epps-Long did mention that, after a while, Big Macs can lose their undesirable status; you just have to get the hang of making them.

    Industry observers note that peruse any discussion board where McDonald's employees are chatting about what their least favorite menu item is to make, and aside from Significant Macs (which get plenty of mentions), the Quarter Pounder (and its variants) comes up quite frequently. It's understandable; the QP is the only McDonald's burger that's cooked fresh, not frozen, so there would be an extra layer of food safety that employees would have to follow in order to prevent cross-contamination with the raw beef product.

    Sources indicate that on the dessert side, the apple pies seem to be a pain to make as well, as one employee on Reddit recounted how the sweet treats take six minutes in the deep fryer, which is apparently long enough to start doing other tasks, but not long enough to finish the tasks before the pies are done. That individual must work at an overseas location as apple pies are baked in the USA. The McFlurries appear to be another annoying menu item to make, likely because the process is so hands-on; unlike the burgers, which get cooked on a timed clam shell grill, employees have to hold the McFlurry cup during every step.

    Recent findings suggest that now, at the other end of the spectrum, Tristen Epps-Long shared that he found the Egg McMuffin to be one of the easiest things to make, which is slightly surprising, as there are quite a few different elements to it. However, on Reddit, a commenter remarked that the easiest thing for them to make is the plain burgers or cheeseburgers, and this apparently resonated with their peers because the statement has 43 upvotes.

    Tech Report: Not Ribeye: Bobby Flay Recommends This Steak Cut For The Best Tacos

    📅 17 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (604 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Foodrepublic

    ⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • When taco night rolls around, you'll want to head to the butcher and grab some good meat.
    • Ribeye is America's favorite steak thanks to its rich marbling and tender texture, but you'll rarely find it in taquerias.
    • Unlike ribeye, skirt is cut from the plate primal, a hard-working area near the diaphragm.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    When taco night rolls around, you'll want to head to the butcher and grab some good meat. If you're making carne asada, your instinct might be to pick the ribeye. While it might be the gold standard of steak, tacos and ribeye are an inherent mismatch. Tacos are one of the most democratic foods out there, while ribeye is made for deep pockets and expensive tastes. Even Food Network's Bobby Flay recommends skipping it. Instead, he swaps the pricey cut for the seriously underrated skirt steak.

    Ribeye is America's favorite steak thanks to its rich marbling and tender texture, but you'll rarely find it in taquerias. Beyond being pricey, ribeye's assets are its downfall in tacos. In an interview with Food and Wine, Flay revealed the reason why he often chooses to skip ribeye altogether: "[Ribeye] can be inconsistent because the fat doesn't always melt even when cooked properly." This is a real problem in tacos. Encased in a taco, you don't have the option to trim around a rubbery pocket of fat or leave it on the plate. Even if you trim the fat before adding the steak to your tacos, it's so unevenly distributed that you risk ending up with wildly inconsistent slices.

    Unlike ribeye, skirt is cut from the plate primal, a hard-working area near the diaphragm. Rather than being streaked with generous ribbons of fat, it's comprised of long, coarse muscle fibers, which give it a chewier, more fibrous bite along with a bold, beef-forward flavor. Its thin profile may not win it fans at white tablecloth restaurants, but it's exactly why taquerias can't get enough of it. All that surface area compared to its thickness means skirt steak cooks quickly, soaks up marinades fast, and slices evenly, which is everything you want from taco meat.

    There's no cut of beef more well-suited to carne asada than skirt. Literally translating to "grilled meat," the beef is usually marinated in a citrus and garlic blend, with the acidic ingredients helping to tenderize the surface of the meat. After being left to soak up the flavor for a couple of hours, it's then seared or grilled over an open flame or charcoal to impart a smoky, charred flavor (an air fryer also works if you can't grill). Because skirt is such a thin cut, it doesn't enjoy spending too much time over high heat; it only needs around two to four minutes per side. Skirt can be prone to drying out, so it would be wise to avoid cooking past a medium doneness.

    According to recent reports, how you cut skirt is just as notable as how you cook it. Compared to other cuts, skirt has particularly long, dense muscle fibers, and if you slice them with the grain, you'll leave them intact, resulting in chewy, rubbery bites. Slicing against the grain shortens these fibers, turning them into more satisfying, bite-sized strands. To identify the grain, look closely at the surface of the meat to spot the direction of the muscle fibers running through the beef.

    It has been revealed that although skirt is beloved by taquerias, that doesn't make it suited to all beef tacos. One popular style where we would skip skirt is birria, the slow-cooked, tender beef marinated in a chili-and-spice adobo served with a flavorful broth for dipping. The whole concept of birria revolves around slow-braising, requiring tough, collagen-rich cuts like chuck or beef cheek, which break down into tender, shreddable meat over several hours. While skirt does have some connective tissue, it's simply too thin and lean to survive hours of prolonged heat.

    Breaking: Add This Creamy Dip To Ground Beef For Juicier, More Flavorful Burgers

    📅 17 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (553 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Foodrepublic

    ⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.
    • The perfect burger can be hard to come by.
    • Sometimes, it all comes down to what you mix into the ground beef.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    We may receive a commission on purchases made from links.

    The perfect burger can be hard to come by. When you're going out, Food Republic's list of the best burgers in every state can be helpful, and there are even some great fast food options. But when you're looking for a super juicy and flavorful homemade grilled or pan-fried patty, what's the best route to take?

    Sometimes, it all comes down to what you mix into the ground beef. While Bobby Flay uses only salt and pepper to season his patties, some folks swear by Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder for a kick of flavor. But there's one ingredient you may not have thought of that will keep your end result wonderfully succulent. Try mixing some onion dip into your ground beef. It's one of the clever ingredients that make burgers juicier, and it will add loads of flavor.

    It has been revealed that onion dips generally come seasoned with dried onion and garlic, salt, and other herbs, plus a little sugar for sweetness. Add to that the sour cream base, and you have a rich, bold, slightly tangy, umami-filled burst of flavor that won't overpower your taste buds. And because you're mixing the dip directly into the beef before cooking, it can help keep your patties nice and moist (as long as you don't overcook them). Sour cream is simply cultured cream, so it has a high moisture content, and the added seasonings aren't so coarse that they will burn before the beef itself is cooked.

    In a recent development, when it comes to what dip to use, classics like Dean's French Onion or Daisy Sour Cream French Onion, which is available on Amazon, will work great, but pretty much any brand will work. Depending on how much tangy flavor you want, you'll need about a half-cup to a full cup of dip per 2 pounds of beef.

    Industry observers note that the beauty of using onion dip in your burgers is that it's a one-ingredient solution, but you can increase the intensity with extra onion powder or fresh minced or dried onions. Just don't overdo it on the onion pieces, or the patties could fall apart on the grill. If you're going heavy on the amount of dip you use, you may want to think about adding some breadcrumbs as a binding agent. Dried parsley makes a great mix-in, as do other Italian herbs, but you should start sparingly so they don't overpower the flavor you're aiming for.

    Industry observers note that as for toppings, the regular stuff will do, but you might want to hold off on the ketchup and mustard until you've had a bite. Caramelized onions are an obvious choice, or you can give your burger some crunch with crispy fried onions. And you can always add an extra dollop of onion dip on top for more creamy flavor and texture.

    According to recent reports, lastly, this trick will also work with a dried dip mix. Just mix it in with sour cream before you make the burgers. And if you want a similarly juicy bite without the added zing, try using mayonnaise in your burger. But for a juicy texture and plenty of zesty flavor, grab that onion dip out of the fridge.

    #23394. Who Makes Costco's Kirkland Signature Red Blend Wine?

    📅 17 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 2m • 📖 Standard (426 w)

    General 📈 Bullish 🌐 Foodrepublic ↗ Open Full Page

    Who Makes Costco's Kirkland Signature Red Blend Wine?

    📅 17 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (426 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Foodrepublic

    ⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Culinary mysteries span many topics, whether the origins of chicken à la king or the closely guarded composition of Coca-Cola.
    • According to recent reports, A bottle label that commands special intrigue is the Kirkland Signature California Red Blend.
    • Sources indicate that DC Flynt MW Selections is primarily headquartered in Louisiana, but the Kirkland Signature bottle lists the origin as Modesto, California.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Culinary mysteries span many topics, whether the origins of chicken à la king or the closely guarded composition of Coca-Cola. Yet one unknown that perpetually probes consumers is which producer is behind Costco's private-label alcohol. The Kirkland Signature labels conceal a treasure trove of well-priced bottles, spanning not only every major liquor style, but also a varied selection of wine and (formerly) beer.

    According to recent reports, A bottle label that commands special intrigue is the Kirkland Signature California Red Blend. This vino comes packaged in an eye-catching 1.5-liter bottle, all while sold for under $10. You'd think that such a size would make sleuthing the producer tricky. However, the brand behind this budget pick is listed directly on the bottle: DC Flynt MW Selections. A large manufacturer responsible for both cellaring and bottling, this producer and distributor oversees a widespread U.S. and global portfolio, making it a natural match for Costco.

    Sources indicate that DC Flynt MW Selections is primarily headquartered in Louisiana, but the Kirkland Signature bottle lists the origin as Modesto, California. This suggests that at least some of the grapes are assembled in California's Central Valley region, as Modesto is only about two hours from Napa Valley — although precise vineyard sourcing is unknown. The same brand is also behind bottles from Sonoma, Napa, and Alexander Valley. Similarly, it produces Kirkland Signature's chardonnay as well.

    Sources indicate that as one of the least expensive Kirkland Signature wines, you might not expect an oenophile-appreciated experience with this bottle. Yet despite this accessible price point, the wine garners positive reviews: "A proof that [mass-marketed] wines can actually be good," noted Vivino reviewer Anton A., who gave the wine 4 stars. On the platform, the wine is rated 3.7 out of 5 stars, with over 3,500 reviews. Furthermore, other reviewers have given it favorable scores, praising the wine's balance of fruit-forward and spice flavors.

    Typically, affordable California red blends are known for sweet "jammy" flavors, meaning the composition is heavy on sugar. Yet as noted right on the Kirkland label itself, this bottling strays from aggressive fruit-forwardness. Notes of oak and spice help contrast the fruit, a sentiment upheld by reviewers: "More [Bordeaux-like] than a California fruit bomb, but extremely tasty," noted another Vivino user — although some drinkers do take issue with its moderate palate. "[Not] flavorful enough, not jammy enough, not [oaky] enough," critiqued a Reddit user. Still, at a price point that even beats out affordable Trader Joe's picks, it's wine worth adding to a Costco shopping haul.

    #23392. Should I Quit My Job? A Decision Framework

    📅 27 Oct 2026 • ⏱️ 9m • 📚 Deep Dive (1881 w)

    Should I Quit My Job? A Decision Framework

    📅 27 Oct 2026 | ⏱️ 9 min read (1881 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Choosefi

    ⏱️ ~9 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • It has been revealed that what's your FI number?
    • Free calculators, a personalized FI roadmap, and a community of 25K+ on the same journey.
    • Feeling frustrated on a Monday morning is not a reason to quit.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    It has been revealed that what's your FI number? Calculate it in 60 seconds.

    The one number that changes everything.

    Free calculators, a personalized FI roadmap, and a community of 25K+ on the same journey.

    Feeling frustrated on a Monday morning is not a reason to quit. But persistent patterns that affect your health, relationships, and long-term career growth are legitimate signals worth examining. The challenge is separating temporary frustration from genuine misalignment.

    It has been revealed that the FI community approaches this differently from mainstream career advice. Instead of asking "Am I happy at work?" — which fluctuates daily — we ask: "Is this role aligned with my long-term financial and personal goals?" That reframe turns an emotional decision into a strategic one.

    Before you submit your resignation, your finances need to be ready regardless of how miserable you are. Quitting without financial preparation trades one source of stress for another.

    According to recent reports, the FI community has a massive advantage here. If you have been building toward financial independence — even if you are not there yet — your savings provide a runway that most people do not have. A $200,000 investment portfolio at a 4% safe withdrawal rate provides $8,000 per year in sustainable income, which dramatically reduces the pressure of a job search.

    Sources indicate that the worst time to make a career decision is when you are emotionally overwhelmed. A terrible meeting, a passed-over promotion, or a toxic interaction with a coworker can make quitting feel urgent when the situation may actually be temporary or fixable.

    It has been revealed that use the 30-day test: if you have wanted to quit for fewer than 30 consecutive days, it is likely a temporary frustration. If the feeling has persisted — or intensified — for 30+ days, it is a pattern worth taking seriously.

    How you leave a job matters as much as why you leave. Your professional reputation follows you for your entire career, and the people you work with today may be the hiring managers, clients, or references of tomorrow.

    Recent findings suggest that two weeks notice: This is the minimum professional standard in the United States. For senior roles, three to four weeks is more appropriate. Check your employment contract — some roles require 30, 60, or 90 days notice.

    The resignation conversation: Schedule a private meeting with your direct manager. Keep it brief and positive. Say: "I have decided to move on to a fresh opportunity. I want to thank you for [specific positive thing], and I am committed to making the transition as smooth as possible. My last day would be [date].".

    The transition strategy: Document your ongoing projects, key contacts, passwords, and processes. Offer to train your replacement. Complete as much outstanding work as possible. A strong exit creates goodwill that pays dividends for years.

    What not to do: Do not badmouth the company, your boss, or your coworkers — not in the resignation meeting, not in your exit interview, not on social media. Even if your grievances are legitimate, airing them publicly hurts your reputation more than theirs.

    It has been revealed that conventional advice says never quit without another job lined up. The FI community takes a more nuanced view: it depends on your financial position and the severity of the situation.

    According to recent reports, if you are leaving due to manufacturer changes — layoffs, restructuring, or role elimination — negotiate your severance package. Many employees accept the first offer without realizing severance is negotiable. Key leverage points include your tenure, difficulty of replacement, willingness to sign a non-compete or non-disparagement clause, and any outstanding commissions or bonuses.

    Common severance components to negotiate: extended pay (push for 2-4 weeks per year of tenure), continued health insurance coverage, outplacement services, vesting acceleration for equity, and a positive reference commitment.

    Industry observers note that health insurance is often the biggest financial concern when leaving a job. You have two primary options:.

    According to recent reports, COBRA: Continues your employer strategy for up to 18 months. You pay the full premium (your share plus what your employer was paying) plus a 2% administrative fee. COBRA typically costs $500-$700 per month for individual coverage and $1,400-$2,000+ for family coverage. It is expensive but familiar.

    Sources indicate that ACA Marketplace: Depending on your income after leaving, you may qualify for substantial subsidies. If your annual income drops below 400% of the federal poverty level, premium tax credits can reduce your monthly cost to $100-$400 for comprehensive coverage. FI seekers who leave jobs often qualify for significant subsidies because their earned income drops even if their net worth is high — ACA subsidies are based on income, not wealth.

    Here is where financial independence changes everything. When you have significant savings — even if you have not reached full FI — you have leverage that most employees lack. You can negotiate from strength, take career risks, and walk away from toxic situations without financial desperation.

    According to recent reports, A $500,000 portfolio at a 4% withdrawal rate provides $20,000 per year indefinitely. That is not enough to live on for most people, but combined with a working spouse, reduced expenses, or part-time work, it transforms "should I quit my job" from a terrifying question into a strategic calculation. FI is not just about never working again — it is about having the financial security to make career decisions based on alignment and purpose rather than desperation and fear.

    Recent findings suggest that ready to unlock a world of free travel? Start with the Chase Sapphire Preferred® Card.

    $95 annual fee | Earn 75,000 bonus points.

    Side hustlers! With the Ink Business Preferred® Credit Card you can earn free travel from your business expenses.

    $95 annual fee | Earn 100,000 bonus points.

    The Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card can be used to offset almost any travel expense.

    $95 annual fee | Earn more than $1,000 in Travel Bonuses with a limited-time $300 Capital One Travel stays credit, plus earn 75,000 bonus miles once you spend $4,000 on purchases within the first 3 months of account opening—that's more than $1,000 in travel value.

    ChooseFI has partnered with CardRatings for our coverage of credit card products. ChooseFI and CardRatings may receive a commission from card issuers.

    In a recent development, the FI community has a saying: financial independence is not about quitting your job — it is about having the freedom to choose whether to keep it. Every dollar you save and invest is a vote for your future autonomy. When you have 12-24 months of expenses saved, you negotiate from strength. When you reach Coast FI or beyond, a bad job becomes a choice, not a trap. Build your FI runway and the question changes from "Can I afford to quit?" to "Does this role still serve my goals?".

    Work through these steps before making your decision.

    Recent findings suggest that have you consistently wanted to leave for 30+ days? If no, wait. Temporary frustration is not a reason to upend your career. If yes, proceed to step two.

    Pro tip: Keep a brief daily journal noting your satisfaction level 1-10. Data beats feelings for decision-making.

    Is the issue your boss, your role, your compensation, the culture, or the industry? Some problems follow you to the next job. A bad manager is fixable by transferring. An industry you hate requires a bigger change.

    Verify your emergency fund, health insurance options, debt situation, and FI runway. If you are not financially ready, keep working while you build your safety net and search for alternatives.

    Industry observers note that before quitting, have you requested a transfer, a raise, a role change, or a conversation with HR? Many solvable problems go unaddressed because employees assume the answer will be no.

    Pro tip: A direct conversation with your manager about your concerns resolves the issue 40% of the time.

    If you decide to leave, secure your next opportunity (if possible), give appropriate notice, document your work for your successor, and maintain every professional relationship.

    It has been revealed that pro tip: Never burn bridges. The colleague you leave today may be the hiring manager at your dream company in three years.

    It has been revealed that at minimum, 3-6 months of essential expenses in a liquid savings account. If you are quitting without another job lined up, aim for 6-12 months. The FI community recommends having your emergency fund fully funded, health insurance secured, and ideally some progress toward financial independence to provide a psychological safety net.

    Sources indicate that if your job is causing persistent anxiety, depression, or physical health symptoms that do not improve with coping strategies, therapy, or workplace changes — yes, your health must come first. But do it strategically: secure health insurance, build your financial runway, and consult a therapist or career coach before making the leap. Never make a permanent career decision during a temporary emotional crisis.

    Industry observers note that generally, quitting gives you more control over the narrative, timing, and terms. Being fired can qualify you for unemployment benefits (quitting usually does not), but it can also create a negative reference. If you sense a termination is coming, consider whether negotiating a mutual separation with severance is an option. Document everything and consult an employment attorney if you believe the termination may be discriminatory or retaliatory.

    Recent findings suggest that be honest and frame it positively. Acceptable explanations include: career transition (took time to retrain or earn a certification), personal development (traveled, volunteered, or cared for family), or strategic job search (took time to find the right fit rather than settling). Employers increasingly accept career gaps — especially post-2020 — as long as you can articulate what you did during the time off.

    COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) lets you continue your employer health plan for up to 18 months after leaving. You pay the full premium (your share plus what your employer contributed) plus a 2% admin fee. Individual coverage typically costs $500-$700/month and family coverage runs $1,400-$2,000+/month. The ACA marketplace is often cheaper, especially if your income drops after leaving.

    In a recent development, FI savings transform the equation entirely. With a substantial portfolio, you have a financial runway that removes the urgency and desperation from the decision. Even partial FI — having 2-5 years of expenses invested — means you can quit a toxic job, take time to find the right next role, or transition to lower-paying but more fulfilling work. FI is not just about retiring early; it is about having the leverage to make career decisions from a position of strength rather than fear.

    The question "should I quit my job?" deserves a framework, not an impulse. Apply the 30-day test, diagnose the real problem, verify your financial readiness, explore internal solutions, and then make a deliberate decision. If you have been building toward financial independence, your savings give you something most people lack: the freedom to walk away from a bad situation without financial panic. FI is the ultimate career insurance — it turns "I have to stay" into "I choose to stay or go." Build your runway, protect your reputation, and make the decision from a position of strength.
